Counsel’s reference to Robert’s sons supports a qualified brother inference for co-plaintiff William. The uncle’s paternal or maternal side and all mothers are unstated. If that surgeon identification is correct, the 1858/1870 mill activity is a concrete death-date conflict. Keep the surgeon and mill documentary accounts separate; Glasgow-3412’s surgeon identity itself remains qualified.
